remoteGateNote: CI ran on 6ec433d, the last commit carrying code. c135e0f sits on top and adds only evidence artifacts, no source or workflow change, matching the plan's metadata-only pattern.
auditResult: One round returned three findings and all three were fixed.
auditFindingsFixed: MEDIUM: Three.js evidence checks were guarded on the raw SI_WORLD_TEST_RENDERER value rather than the effective renderer, so a smoke requesting none could label its output threejs-2d while skipping the context-lifecycle proof, the renderer evidence and the presented-zoom assertion.
LOW: WorldScene still defaulted rendererKind to skia and the dev harness omits the prop, so every harness scene silently exercised the deprecated path.
LOW: selectedRenderer fell back to skia in windowless environments.
ciFailuresFixed: macos-15-intel blocklists WebGL 2, so the functional suite could not start the production renderer. Moving the job was attempted and reverted, because tests/electron/security.test.ts asserts that runner and the job proves x64 hardware itself. It now runs the functional suite on the temporary Skia path, and the blocklist is recorded as a Stage 7 blocker rather than silenced with a software-rendering flag.

The ARM64 packaged world smoke failed capturing the loading shell. The production renderer no longer waits for CanvasKit, so the loading window is shorter than a capture takes. Both a shell that never appeared and one that vanished mid-capture are now recorded as not observed rather than failed, while a capture that fails on its own still throws.
stage7Blocker: macos-15-intel blocklists WebGL 2. Stage 7 deletes Skia, after which that job has no renderer it can start and a real Intel Mac hitting the same blocklist cannot run the shipped game. See artifacts/threejs-2d/stage-6/STOP-CONDITION.md for the three ways to settle it.
